g.title: MlQube: Enterprise ML Platform on AWS
g.text: MlQube: Enterprise ML Platform on AWS
5 · Full view · hub-and-spoke EKS clusters · one tenant per business unit · infrastructure as code with Terraform

g.title: legend
g.text: Developer submits a Python/Hera job → Argo Workflows → Kueue → Karpenter GPU node
Job logs runs and registers the model → shared MLflow (metadata → RDS, artifacts → S3 prefix)
Model promotion → GitOps PR in GitHub → Argo CD → KServe canary in prod
GitOps: Argo CD (management) → both workload clusters
Crossplane provisions per-tenant S3 bucket, IAM role, namespaces
SSO: IAM Identity Center (SAML, via Dex) → Backstage, Argo Workflows UI, MLflow; groups per tenant
Metrics/cost: all clusters → central observability → OpenCost → per-BU cost report
